AEGS_Hammerhead.note: Legacy entry (40 SCU, 5×6.25×2.5 m grid, no MaxSize, no cargo hardpoints) superseded by AEGS_Hammerhead_GS, which carries the current 64 SCU grid. Hidden so the index has one Hammerhead.

DRAK_Ironclad.note: Game data reports MaxSize 1.25 m³ (1 SCU) for the four open-deck hold grids, which contradicts in-game use (32 SCU containers are loaded routinely; see docs/research/01-data-sources.md §12). Allow every size that fits. Names follow the hardpoints (rear/front × left/right); the automatic labels drop rear/front because every grid of a class shares them.

DRAK_Ironclad_Assault.note: Same open deck as the Ironclad (two 720 SCU hold grids with a bogus 1 SCU MaxSize). Allow every size that fits.

RSI_Hermes.note: Both 144 SCU main grids (5×22.5×2.5 m, role Medium Freight) report MaxSize 1.25 m³ (1 SCU), the same defect as the Ironclad's open deck; taken literally the 288 SCU freighter would reject every 2+ SCU box. Allow every size that fits geometrically (unverified in-game).

DRAK_Golem_OX.note: The 64 SCU external bed (5×10×2.5 m, role Light Freight) reports MaxSize 1.25 m³ (1 SCU), the same defect as the Ironclad's open deck. Allow every size that fits geometrically (unverified in-game).

ESPR_Prowler_Utility.note: Both 16 SCU external grids (2.5×5×2.5 m) report MaxSize 1.25 m³ (1 SCU), the same defect as the Ironclad's open deck. Allow every size that fits the 2×4×2-cell grid (unverified in-game).

CNOU_Nomad.note: MinSize/MaxSize are missing from the game data. The 3.75×5×2.5 m bed would geometrically take a 16 SCU box, but the open bed is capped at 8 SCU here until verified in-game.

DRAK_Cutlass_Black.note: Game data reports MaxSize 2.5×1.25×1.25 m (2 SCU) for the 40 SCU main grid, which is far too restrictive: in-game the bay takes larger boxes. Allow up to 8 SCU (unverified in-game; 16 SCU would fit the 5×6.25 m floor geometrically).

ORIG_135c.note: The 135c reuses the 100i grid class for its second compartment, so the inferred label was the class name. Game data also lacks MaxSize and hardpoints for both grids.

GAMA_Railen.note: Grid class names are capacity codes (IS_64 / IS_128) that humanise badly ('IS 64 left'); the racks are named after their matched hardpoints (left/right × bottom/side/top) and grouped into left/right bays.

MISC_Starlancer_Max.note: The two 2.5×20×2.5 m grids the MAX adds over the TAC (hardpoints cargo_grid_l / cargo_grid_r, class MISC_Starlancer_CargoGrid_Max_Template) would otherwise be labelled 'Max left' / 'Max right'.
